description: Source code for managing cron events, including registration, scheduling, updating, and handling cron events via callbacks. Implements thread-safe operations and interacts with system crontab.

methods.name: registerForCronEvent
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific cron event, optionally creating a new crontab entry if schedule is provided.

methods.name: updateCronEventSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule of an existing cron event identified by name.

methods.name: unregisterForCronEvent
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for a cron event, optionally removing the crontab entry.
